text:
tanya.l: heads up / quick sync: multiple vendors gave overlapping GA windows for H200 (Vendor Y), H100 (Vendor X) and MI300 (Vendor Z) in June. need a plan for marketplace staging + SI onboarding.
kevin_r: do we have hard dates? X = mid-June, Y = early-June, Z = Jun 20-24, Gaudi unknown.
nina_ops: marketplace freeze Jun 10-16, creative & compliance. overlapping GAs will create churn.
sam-platform: Dedicated needs perf tags and driver matrix by Jun 3. SI teams need ~2 weeks to certify.
vendor-pm: Vendor Y can shift +/-5 days for ordered rollout. Vendor X prefers fixed mid-June.
tanya.l: propose sequence: H200 (Y) -> H100 (X) -> MI300 (Z) -> Gaudi, with 48-72h stagger per vendor for press embargo.
kevin_r: X might push back, they want first. can we do soft-launches?
nina_ops: yes, soft-launch marketplace tiles (no press) for later vendors so SI can start early.
sam-platform: soft-launch flag ready in staging; need allowlists.
vendor-pm: we can deliver driver bundles early if you give delivery format/date.
tanya.l: action items: vendors deliver driver bundles by Jun 1; Redwood cert windows Jun 2-6; public press begins Jun 7 with staggered cadence.
release-bot: NOTE: release-bot will open canary for H200 on 2024-06-03T04:00Z.
kevin_r: confirm B200 fallback in kernel matrix? some customers still on B200 nodes.
sam-platform: adding b200-driver-2.0.x to matrix.
nina_ops: legal wants embargo windows written; marketing needs final copy by Jun 4.
vendor-pm: require 48h review for joint language.
tanya.l: recap: Jun 1 drivers in; Jun 2-6 certs; Jun 7 H200 public; Jun 9 H100 public; Jun 12 MI300 soft + SI beta; Jun 15 Gaudi staging. tentative pending vendor confirmations.
kevin_r: I'll host vendor call Mon Jun 3 17:00 PT. agenda: delivery format, embargo windows, staging flags, SI cadence, creative signoff.
sam-platform: will post canary checklist and automation links.
nina_ops: I'll prep marketplace tiles with fallback copy and SI dev notes.
vendor-pm: vendors confirmed Y and Z; X tentative. will send invites.
tanya.l: thanks all. please drop call notes and any major changes here. :thumbsup:
